values.note: 54 'RV or Tent' sites (A-loop and others) with listed lengths 30-60 ft, one 24-ft tent-only site, and 86 horse stalls booked separately. The total length counts the tow vehicle: 'Vehicle with camper attached must fit completely in the site'.

values.note: Florida Forest Service campground on its own ReserveAmerica site (or 1-877-879-3859): 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance' (window shown Oct 21 2026 to Sep 21 2027). Horse stalls are reserved with the campsite. Campgrounds close, with automatic refunds, when the county is under a tropical storm or hurricane warning.

values.note: The Florida Forest Service offers camping discounts for people 65 and older, active-duty military or honorably discharged veterans, and the 100% disabled 'at applicable camping facilities'; documentation is registered by calling (877) 879-3859.

note: Florida Forest Service. General drive-in RV campground that also offers equestrian facilities (horses only in corrals/trails, not at sites — non-horse RVers welcome).
summary: Confirmed on the Florida State Forests ReserveAmerica site and FDACS: 54 RV/tent sites to 60 ft with 30/50-amp electric and water, restrooms and showers, open year-round, reservable same-day to 11 months ahead. Nothing restricts the campground to horse campers (horses are kept in corrals/stalls, not at sites). Fees left (human-read 2026-10-12, $22.32). policy_ref is 'none' as expected. Added the FFS military/veteran camping discount. Note: site/hookup/booking text dropped as structured.
